title: estimate/1: detection parameters measured on several files, put together, with their evidence
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli estimate FILE... --json` (plus the citation member) and of the `lr_estimate` op (same bytes in the site and the app): each file's `estimates/1`, per value the median over the files with the figures behind it, and the plan parameters it would set. A measurement of these files, never a setting: nothing is applied. Not to be confused with `estimates/1` (plural, one file, what the Flow step `features.estimate` writes): `files` holds those. Code: crates/mzlab-core/src/estimates.rs.

estimated.description: Files whose values are in the medians (the group most files share).

no_estimate.description: Files with no estimates/1 (read error); the CLI exits 1 when it is above 0.

polarity.description: Polarity of the group the values come from; 0 when the files did not decide.

axis.description: Axis of that group: Da or ppm; empty when no file has an estimate.

files.description: Per file the `estimates/1` object (with `decided`: what the file decided on its own, name, value and proof) or {file, error: error/1}.

values.description: One entry per measure, in the order noise_floor, min_height, ppm, da, fwhm, rt_tol, dead, defect.

points.description: Evidence only: the points (peaks) the measurement was made from, summed over the files (ppm, da, fwhm); null for the others. NOT the weight of the median, which counts every file once.

params.description: The plan parameters the values would set. With a plan (`--emit-set`): one entry per instance of the step in the plan; without: the instance is the last part of the step id.

current.description: What the plan writes for the parameter now; null when it does not write it.

rule.description: How the value was made, with the polarity and axis of the group of files that fed it and the number of files.

points.description: Evidence only, as in `values`; not a weight.

reason.description: noValue: not measured; axis: the parameter is for the other axis; noInstance: the plan has no instance of the step.

hints.description: The nominal-resolution profile named as a `--set` line, one entry per instance of features.detect (default instance `detect` without a plan), when the files in the group show the signature (their `estimates/1` has `nominal.hint` true). Never applied and never in `params`; empty when no file shows it.

current.description: What the plan writes for preset now; null when it does not write it.

of.description: Files of the group that carry the nominal member.

between_share.description: Median over those files of the share of candidate rows between the two heights.

split_share.description: Median of the share of ions split across the grids.

left_out.description: Files with a polarity or axis other than the group the values come from.

choices.description: Every automatic choice: what, value, why.

notes.description: {key, params} messages: warn.estimate.mixed, note.estimate.fewFiles (fewer than 3 files), note.estimate.nominal (the signature of the nominal profile; see `hints`).
